Default assistant system prompt

default_system_prompt.Rd

Builds the four-section system prompt the assistant ships by default: an intro / conventions block, an auto-generated tool catalogue from client$get_tools(), a compact board summary, and (when applicable) a one-line note carrying the previous turn's flush rejection.

Usage

default_system_prompt(board = NULL, client = NULL, last_flush = NULL, ...)

Arguments

board

Reactive containing the live board, as supplied to the extension server. NULL omits the board section.

client

An ellmer::Chat. NULL omits the tool catalogue.

last_flush

Reactive holding the previous turn's flush rejection message (character) or NULL. NULL (or a NULL value) omits the delta note.

...

Forward-compatibility slot for future inputs.

Value

A character scalar.

Details

Each argument is optional; the corresponding section is omitted when its input is NULL, so default_system_prompt() at the REPL returns just the intro block – useful for inspecting what the default looks like without mounting a board.

This is the default value of new_assistant_extension's system_prompt argument. Custom functions passed in its place receive (board, client, last_flush, ...); the ... is forward-compatibility headroom for future phases adding inputs (accept ... in custom functions so the call site can grow without breaking you).
